rules.source_version: Explicit source_updated_at; UTC; never inferred from ingestion time
rules.late_arrival: Ignore older versions; exact replay preserves the original audit time
rules.deletion: Retain tombstones; missing snapshot rows are not implicit deletes
rules.money: Exact decimal(18,2); reject fractional cents and unsupported currencies
rules.source_timestamps: Explicit UTC offset on wire timestamps
rules.quantity: Integer from 0 through 10000 for canonical orders
rules.unit_price: Nonnegative, at most INR 500000, exact cents
rules.single_line_scope: One product per order/receipt; no separate tax/shipping/discount
rules.customer_identity: Channel scoped; POS walk-in identity is receipt scoped
rules.inventory_entity: Source-qualified SKU, one declared location and fixed standard cost
rules.inventory_coverage: Actual daily stock observations; missing/zero denominator produces null turnover
rules.bronze_partition: UTC ingestion date with retained immutable batch identity
rules.publication: Exact independent reconciliation and seven GE suites before atomic CURRENT
rules.public_export: No raw payloads, customer IDs, credentials or local file paths

compatibility.additive: Disposable Iceberg add-column/time-travel proof; assess consumers before production evolution
compatibility.breaking: Reject incompatible type changes; introduce a new contract/table with explicit migration
